reason: Design contract 3. Clause (1) is Stembridge Prop. 1.1: the projection of a word to two noncommuting letters is a commutation-class invariant, so a reduced word containing the full alternating factor gives a reduced word outside its class, and conversely the first braid move leaving the class is a long braid move. Clause (2) is Stembridge Prop. 2.3: necessity of (a) and (b) uses the convex-chain contiguity lemma and reducedness; sufficiency was checked in the form recorded here, where (a) first gives that the braid class equals the commutativity class (a long braid move would create a convex alternating chain in an isomorphic heap), then Matsumoto's M-reducedness clause (2) rules out a non-reduced s via a consecutive equal pair, and finally Matsumoto (1) gives R(w)=C(s). This is exactly the design's 'Tits deletion algorithm' route and uses Nadeau Lemma 2.4 as the independent formulation. Suppliers read and recorded: thm-hh-matsumoto-reduced-word-theorem clauses (1)-(3), def-hh-coxeter-matrix-word-group-and-length, the two local lemmas, the heap classification theorem. No AC use.
